column1: # Old Irish grapheme table (Old Irish spec §6, §11; plan Task 7, O-27, O-28, O-29, O-14).
# Read by `strands.spelled.load_graphemes`. Columns: token env left ipa role punctum note.
#   token    lower-case letters as written (1-3 chars); `n-` is the written nasal prefix.
#   env      initial | noninitial | final | any. `initial` = the word's first token;
#            `final` = its last token (the §40/§41 final digraphs must not swallow a medial
#   left     letters, one of which must END the previous token (digest §10.2 conv. 4), or -.
#   ipa      `+`-joined segments of features.tsv, or - for silent.
#   role     cons | vowel | long | nasal | glide | silent | ending (spelled.ROLES).
#   punctum  the plain-letter form substituted when `punctum = off` (O-14), or -.
# The loader sorts by token length, LONGEST FIRST; within a length, file order is the
# tie-break. Where two rows share a token the more specific one comes first (`initial`
# before `noninitial`; a non-empty `left` before an empty one): this order is load-bearing
# for conv. 4. The BROAD/SLEN quality of a consonant is NOT in this table: it is the
# reconstruction's quality pass (digest §10.2 conv. 5) over the declared `quality-pairs`.
# Non-initial ⟨mb nd ng⟩ are cluster tokens (conv. 4: *imb* /imʲbʲ/, *long* /Loŋɡ/) so that
# the nasal is a nasal and not the lenited /ṽ/ of a single non-initial ⟨m⟩.
# ⟨mb⟩ CONFLICT (O-29): digest §10.2 master table says ⟨mb⟩ = /m/; §10.4's *a m-bo* /a mbo/
# suggests a cluster. The master table is followed.
